description:
List segment, geography and share-class metric disclosures

Return source disclosure rows classified as SEGMENT, GEOGRAPHY or SHARE_CLASS; a SHARE_CLASS row is one class's cover-page shares outstanding. Deterministic ordering: statement_date DESC NULLS LAST, dimension_type ASC, axis_qname ASC, member_qname ASC, metric_code ASC, period_start ASC, period_end ASC, value ASC, with a fixed tie-break. A value is identified by its company and those fields; a value the filing reports more than once is listed once.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key. Provide this, company_id, or `ticker`. Send `cik` or `ticker`, not both.

company_id.description: Company identifier (UUID). Provide this or cik.

dimension_type.description: Optional dimension type filter: SEGMENT, GEOGRAPHY or SHARE_CLASS.

period.description: Optional statement period end date filter (YYYY-MM-DD).

ticker.description: Company filter by ticker symbol, in place of `cik`.

name: metrics_segments
